reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are recorded for the Vertex AI completion-token accounting change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR corrects under-reported completion usage for thinking Gemini models in the Python Vertex AI connector, extending the approach from the Google AI fix in #14671. **Changes:** - Adds a shared helper that sums candidate and thinking token counts. - Uses the helper in chat and text response metadata, including streaming paths. - Adds tests for token-count combinations, absent metadata, and both services’ usage reporting. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​test_vertex_ai_utils.py` | Adds helper and service-level token accounting tests. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​vertex_ai_text_completion.py` | Includes thinking tokens in text completion usage. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​vertex_ai_chat_completion.py` | Includes thinking tokens in chat completion usage. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​utils.py` | Adds the shared completion-token counting helper. |
Review effort: Balanced
